instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: battle passes ruined multiplayer.

Fortnite made the battle pass standard. Now every shooter wants your daily log-in, not your fun. Halo used to unlock armor by playing well. Halo Infinite put it behind a paid seasonal track. Call of Duty seasons turn your free time into a second job. Bring back unlocks you earn. Agree?
